cards.title: Market Mind is ready for the news feed
cards.dek: The app is now designed to run as a simple GitHub Pages experience with story cards supplied by the Market Mind research workflow.
cards.insight: Each story will explain what happened, why it matters and which stocks or sectors may be affected.

cards.title: One swipe. One market story.
cards.dek: Market Mind will focus on the stories investors actually want to understand — ASX, US markets, company announcements, sectors, macro and major market moves.
cards.insight: The goal is not to replace a financial news terminal. It is to make market intelligence fast, visual and easy to understand.
